sentences.text: A dorsal vertebral centrum—a central body of a back vertebra—reaches 15.9 cm in height, which is about 39.75 % of the comparable bone in Patagotitan.
Its estimated mass of 3.5 to 4.3 tonnes represents roughly 6.3 % of the weight of Patagotitan.
The genus and its sole species were formally described in 2026 by Nicholas R. Longrich and colleagues.
To date, only a single fossil occurrence of this titanosaur is recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
The type species anchoring the genus is Phosphatotitan khouribgaensis.
Phosphatotitan inhabited the Ouled Abdoun Basin of Morocco during the Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous, roughly 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
